module.purpose: Defines the core TypeScript types, enums, and state shape for RTK Query's internal API state, including query/mutation substates, status flags, subscription options, and combined store structure.
module.summary: This file is a pure type-definition module for Redux Toolkit Query. It declares the shape of query and mutation state substates, the QueryStatus enum (with string constants to avoid bundle bloat), request status flag unions, subscription and refetch configuration options, infinite query types, and the combined root state structure. A single runtime helper computes status flags from a status value. The module is imported across RTK Query packages to ensure consistent typing of cache, invalidation, and subscription state.
module.businessContext: RTK Query client-side data fetching/caching. If broken, query/mutation state, refetch, and invalidation behavior fail across the app.
functions: getRequestStatusFlags (~L128-136): Returns RequestStatusFlags object derived from a QueryStatus enum value

Set isLoading true only when status is pending
Set isSuccess true only when status is fulfilled
Set isError true only when status is rejected

STATUS_* constants mirror QueryStatus enum string values exactly

detail.name: getRequestStatusFlags
postconditions: The returned object always contains the input status in the status field.
isUninitialized is true iff status equals STATUS_UNINITIALIZED.
isLoading is true iff status equals STATUS_PENDING.
isSuccess is true iff status equals STATUS_FULFILLED.
isError is true iff status equals STATUS_REJECTED.
detail.summary: Maps a QueryStatus enum value into a RequestStatusFlags object containing the raw status plus boolean flags for uninitialized, loading, success, and error states.

specTests.then: the returned object has isUninitialized === true and all other flags false
the returned object has isError === true and all other flags false
